title: Crown-Bell Baron
text: A velvet-coated sector magnate arrives with brass writ-drones, fake civic authority, and a private mob that calls every route fee a public service.
flavor: He never conquered a district. He invoiced it until it knelt.

defeatReward.text: You seize the Baron's stamped writ case and expose a route-fee fraud.
